problems.title: The problem of document disorganization in companies
paragraphs: The reality for many companies is the same: documents scattered across emails, local folders, shared drives, and different systems. Everyone keeps files their own way, and when someone needs a specific document, a real search begins that wastes time and creates frustration.

Manual processes based on spreadsheets and individual controls create serious inconsistencies. There's dependence on specific people who "know where everything is," and when they go on vacation or leave the company, that knowledge leaves with them. Rework becomes routine.

The operational risks are concrete: missed deadlines from lack of follow-up, expired documents with no warning, contract errors from outdated versions, and difficulty locating critical files at decisive moments. Lack of visibility over documentation undermines decision-making and business efficiency.

paragraphs: Tukana AI uses automation and intelligence to simplify document organization and process control for your company. The technology works behind the scenes, classifying files, identifying patterns, and generating alerts automatically.

You don't need technical knowledge to use the platform. The interface is simple and intuitive, designed so anyone on the team can upload, organize, and find documents with ease. No operational complexity.
The focus is on solving practical day-to-day problems: finding files quickly, knowing the status of each document, getting expiration reminders, and having clear reports to support management.
